modeSwitch.prompt: Sustain the blades. Amass them around one creature (Gokei), condense them into a cage around you and one enemy (Senkei), or let them keep scattering.

description.value:
Frequency once per round

Move the second emanation up to 30 feet, or switch modes:

  • Gokei (Total Scene) — the second emanation shrinks to a 10-foot burst centred on one enemy; that enemy takes double the damage and cannot benefit from cover or concealment against it.
  • Senkei (Slaughterscape) — the blades condense into a 20-foot cage around you and one enemy. Neither of you can leave; your Strikes against that enemy ignore all resistances, and you may make one extra Strike each round at your current multiple attack penalty. You lose Senbonzakura's reach and cover-ignoring, and enemies outside the cage cannot be targeted by you.

Choosing neither returns the blades to their scattered state.
